examples.title: Review a document in Claude Code
prerequisites: Install Vale in Claude Code with plugin and lifecycle-hook support. Provide Python 3.11+ and Vale 3.23+. Native Windows isn't supported.
examples.expected_behavior: Report configured findings with their file, line, rule, and correction. Leave the document unchanged.

examples.title: Revise technical prose in Claude Code
examples.input_or_trigger: /vale:google-prose Write a setup guide for the existing server in docs/setup.md.

examples.title: Revise technical prose in Codex

examples.expected_behavior: Revise technical prose, preserve commands and meaning, and verify the result with Vale. Report unresolved findings.

examples.title: Revise a procedure in Claude Code
examples.input_or_trigger: /vale:procedural-prose Rewrite this procedure as a clear procedure: "If the backup succeeds, stop the service and install the update." Preserve the condition and action order.
prerequisites: Install Vale in Claude Code with plugin and lifecycle-hook support. Provide Python 3.11+ and Vale 3.23+. Native Windows isn't supported. The procedural skill is experimental.
examples.expected_behavior: For the example condition, keep the condition before two ordered steps: stop the service, then install the update. This is illustrative guidance, not an evaluated result or ASD-STE100 certification.

claude-code.notes: Invoke skills as namespaced slash commands. The shared lifecycle hooks require a supported Claude Code plugin runtime. The host requires Python 3.11+ and Vale 3.23+; native Windows isn't supported.

codex.notes: Invoke skills with $vale:skill-name or select them with /skills. Review and trust hooks in /hooks. Codex 0.158.0 doesn't recognize /prompts:vale; only older clients that support custom prompts can use the separate legacy template. The host requires Python 3.11+ and Vale 3.23+; native Windows isn't supported.

windows.notes: Native Windows isn't supported because the runtime uses fcntl for state locking. Windows Subsystem for Linux is supported.

slack.notes: The repository doesn't document a Slack integration.

hooks.description: When the first tool call starts a new session, establish the workspace file-state baseline and return empty JSON on success without linting unchanged files.
After a tool changes an eligible document and Vale finds a configured issue, check the changed file and add findings to model context while preserving the tool's original output and exit status.

When the agent is ready to finish with findings remaining in a touched file, check it and request one correction pass. On the active retry, report remaining findings without requesting another continuation.
